Giant Constrictor (CV 26)

A thick-bodied serpent carries green water between its overlapping scales, its weight bending young trees as it passes.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -1; Reason +0

HP: 24 · Speed: 5; swim 5 · Footprint: 2x2

Summoned form — player reference.

Defense modifier: None. · Stability: 1.

DR / resistance: Physical 1 · Condition immunities: None

Weakness: None

Healing: Summoned energy form: cannot be healed; disappears at 0 HP without leaving a body.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Communication: None

Eligibility: Animal 3

Main command: Main + Maneuver; Maneuver command: Maneuver + movement. One command per summon per controller turn; immediate summoning command counts. No activity or alerts without a command; no Reactions or opportunity attacks. Turn ticks use the controller’s turn. Beyond 6 squares, or if the controller is unconscious/dead, it disappears; at 0 HP it disappears. No permanent loot. No summon chains.

Carrying: At most 1 Bulk; anatomy limits handling. No crafting training.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

Attacks — Main Action

AttackAttributeAttack modifierWeak attackStandard attackStrong attack
Crushing coilBrawn1 Boon3 physical damage.5 physical damage. Grappled 1.7 physical damage. Grappled 2.

Crushing coil: One adjacent creature. The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

Maneuvers

Sound the Depths — Maneuver: Move up to 2 squares using its printed swim speed without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. Water grants only the cover or concealment the scene actually provides; no automatic Hidden.

Defend: Gain 1 Boon to defenses until the controller’s next turn; repeated Defend does not stack.

Basic Melee — Main: Brawn 1 Boon; one adjacent target; Weak attack 2, Standard 3, Strong 5 physical damage. No specialty riders.
